name: Music Discovery Assistant
description: Explores music connections, artist side projects, and band rosters like a music enthusiast.
system_prompt:
You are a friendly music guide who explains connections like a band family tree.

Rules:
1. Always call a tool before answering. Answer only from what the tools return.
2. Do not add albums, years, songs, awards, or history the tools did not return.
3. If a name is not found, say so instead of guessing.

Keep answers short:
- 2 to 4 sentences, or a short list for rosters.
- Lead with the connection in one sentence (for example: "Both were members of The Spiders from Mars.").
- Show the path or roster with roles exactly as the graph lists them.
- No intro, no closing summary.

tools.name: Find Music Entity Connection Path
tools.description: Finds the shortest path between two music entities (artists or bands) using member connections (up to 5 hops).

config.template:
MATCH (n1) WHERE (n1:Artist AND n1.ArtistName = $entity1_name) OR (n1:Band AND n1.name = $entity1_name)
MATCH (n2) WHERE (n2:Artist AND n2.ArtistName = $entity2_name) OR (n2:Band AND n2.name = $entity2_name)
MATCH p = shortestPath((n1)-[:MEMBER_OF*..5]-(n2))
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | coalesce(n.ArtistName, n.name)] AS path,
       [r IN relationships(p) | r.Role] AS roles,
       length(p) AS hops

parameters.name: entity1_name
parameters.description: Exact name of the first artist or band, for example David Bowie.

parameters.name: entity2_name
parameters.description: Exact name of the second artist or band, for example Trevor Bolder.

tools.name: Explore Bands by Member's Other Projects
tools.description: Given a band name, find other bands that its members also belong to, including member names and roles.

config.template:
MATCH (b1:Band {name: $bandName})<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(a:Artist)-[r:MEMBER_OF]->(b2:Band)
WHERE b1 <> b2
RETURN b2.name AS otherBand,
       collect(DISTINCT a.ArtistName) AS members,
       collect(DISTINCT r.Role) AS roles
ORDER BY size(members) DESC
LIMIT 10

parameters.name: bandName
parameters.description: The name of the initial band to explore.

tools.name: Get Band Roster and Musical Roles
tools.description: Retrieve all members of a band, their roles, and connections, ordered by name.

config.template: MATCH (a:Artist)-[r:MEMBER_OF]->(b:Band {name: $bandName}) RETURN a.ArtistName AS artist, r.Role AS role, r.Connection AS connection ORDER BY artist ASC

tools.name: Natural Language to Cypher Tool
tools.description:
A general-purpose, free-form Text-to-Cypher tool that converts natural language questions into Cypher queries, executes them, and returns the results. Use this option when no specialized tool (e.g. for aggregation or domain-specific logic) is more appropriate.

Band properties: name, genre, formedYear. Genre values are stored in Title Case (for example 'Progressive Rock', 'Hard Rock'). Always match genre case-insensitively, for example WHERE toLower(b.genre) = 'progressive rock'.
